youtube_description:
We had a great RV Camping trip at Collier-Seminole State Park south of Naples FL.  We did a guided canoe trip that was really informative.  We also went to the beach at Marco Island. It had been a long time since I got to fly my drone and we got some good footage.

Another fun camping trip in the Thor Axis RV.  Be careful picking a campsite here - ours was only 12 feet wide.  Most are in full sun.
